No flag needed - inspected per brief's 'Collection pages need inspection' rule and it passed as a real listing. Every child URL opened directly and confirmed similarly (page titles, product tiles, facets-count header rendered twice per page with matching counts, used as qty evidence). Children sum (220+132+57+71+13+14+8+37=552) slightly EXCEEDS the parent (512) - this indicates some overlap between sibling children (a product appearing under e.g. both New Furniture and New Decor) whose union is smaller than the arithmetic sum; each individual page's own reported count is still the exact site-reported figure for that page and is used as-is, per brief Sec.3 (overlap is expected, not an error). No local-language equivalents applicable (US site). Checked main nav/meganav JS object and page content; did not find a separate '/collections/new' or similar alias beyond the Shopline /c-<id>-...
